relocation.title: Move to another server
relocation.intro: Carries every application of this server onto another one, which may have nothing installed: its folder with git, images, volumes, files and .env, then its data restored from a fresh backup. This server is left as it is.

steps.label: Steps
steps.rewrite_env: Write the new folder into the .env

target.intro: Choose the server the applications move to. It may have nothing installed: the move installs what they need.
target.none: There is no other server yet. Add the new server first.

applications.intro: Every application moves by default. Untick the ones that stay, and choose the name and folder each takes on the new server.
applications.name: Name on the new server
applications.nameHint: Each application in the manager has a name of its own.
applications.folderHint: The same folder unless you change it.

plan.blocked: Something stops the move. Fix what is listed, then plan again.

reasons.database_volume: the database's own data, restored instead

databaseActions.restore: {vendor}: a new database, then the fresh backup restored
databaseActions.shared: {vendor} on another machine: shared, never restored over

pythonActions.carry: The virtualenv moves as it is (Python {version})
pythonActions.rebuild: The virtualenv is made again and its packages installed (Python {version})

blockers.os_unsupported: The new server's system is not one the move can install on: Debian, Ubuntu, RHEL and its rebuilds, or Fedora.
blockers.architecture_mismatch: The new server's processor differs, so the images cannot run there.
blockers.sudo_missing: The new server has no sudo, so nothing can be installed.
blockers.not_enough_space: The new server lacks the space for what moves.
blockers.manager_space_low: The manager's disk lacks room for the largest item that passes through it.
blockers.port_in_use: A port the application publishes is already taken on the new server.
blockers.target_folder_not_empty: {path} already holds something on the new server.
blockers.file_exists_on_target: {path} is already on the new server.
blockers.image_exists_on_target: A different {image} is already on the new server.
blockers.volume_exists_on_target: The volume {volume} is already on the new server.
blockers.unit_exists_on_target: The service {path} is already on the new server.
blockers.site_exists_on_target: The site {path} is already on the new server.
blockers.container_exists_on_target: A container named {name} is already on the new server.
blockers.container_options_unsupported: The container uses options the move cannot set up again. Run it from a compose file first.
blockers.container_missing: The container {name} is not on this server.
blockers.compose_provider_unavailable: Podman on the new server's system cannot run compose files.
blockers.epel_required: podman-compose on RHEL comes from EPEL. Enable EPEL on the new server first.
blockers.passphrase_missing: The application has no backup passphrase yet.
blockers.name_taken: Another application already has the name {name}.
blockers.database_name_unsupported: The database or its user has a name the move cannot create safely.

notes.same_machine: Both servers are the same machine.
notes.python_version_differs: Python {source} here and {target} on the new server; the virtualenv is made again.
notes.venv_rebuilt: The virtualenv is made again on the new server and its packages installed from the internet.
notes.env_mentions_folder: The .env names the old folder; the move writes the new folder in its place.
notes.compose_absolute_path: A compose file names the old folder. Check it once the application has moved.
notes.git_remote_has_credentials: The git remote held a password or token; it was left out of what is shown.
notes.git_uncommitted_changes: The folder has changes not committed to git; they move too.
notes.mysql_replaced_by_mariadb: MySQL is installed as MariaDB on Debian.
notes.process_manager_not_carried: A Supervisor file names the folder; set it up again on the new server.
notes.database_shared_with_source: The database runs on another machine: both servers use it, and nothing is restored over it.
notes.tls_certificate_missing: The site {name} needs certificates the new server lacks; it is installed but left off until they are there.
notes.firewall_may_block: The new server's firewall may block the application's ports.
notes.selinux_enforcing: SELinux is enforcing on the new server; the moved files get their contexts set again.
notes.facts_unknown: The application did not say which database it uses; the move takes a backup and restores it.
notes.volume_size_unknown: The size of {volume} could not be read.
notes.source_sudo_needed: Some files on this server need sudo to read; the move asks for its sudo password.
notes.database_reach_from_container: The database runs on the server itself; let the containers reach it on the new server.
notes.broker_queue_not_carried: Messages waiting in the task queue are not carried.

confirm.intro: The move installs what {target} lacks, carries the applications and restores their data. Nothing on this server changes.
confirm.resuming: This resumes move {job} from where it stopped.
confirm.sudoHint: Leave it empty if the account needs none. It is used for this move only and never kept.
confirm.sourceSudoHint: Used only to read files the SSH user cannot read on this server.

run.passwordHint: Your own password, to confirm it is you.

done.cutover: The applications run on {target}. {source} still runs, untouched: point the traffic at {target} when ready.
done.leftovers: Left on the new server by a step that stopped:

errors.same_server: Choose a server other than this one.
errors.nothing_to_move: This server runs no application to move.
errors.move_blocked: Something stops the move; the plan lists what.
errors.server_move_running: A move already runs on one of these servers.
errors.move_not_resumable: Only a move for real that stopped can be resumed.
errors.sudo_needs_tty: sudo on the server asks for a terminal; allow the SSH user without one.
errors.privileged_command_failed: A command run as root on the server failed.
errors.package_install_failed: The packages could not be installed.
errors.repository_key_mismatch: The repository's signing key is not the expected one.
errors.transfer_digest_mismatch: What arrived differs from what was sent.
errors.target_folder_not_empty: Something is already in the folder on the new server.
errors.file_exists_on_target: A file the move writes is already on the new server.
errors.database_exists_on_target: The database is already on the new server.
errors.database_is_the_sources: The moved application's settings still name this server's database, so nothing was written to it.
errors.database_credentials_unknown: The moved application did not say which database it uses.
errors.moved_application_not_found: The moved application was not found on the new server.
errors.image_mismatch: The image on the new server is not the one sent.
